chunks: Al-Mudaffar ibn Ja'far ibn Al-Mudaffar al-Alawi al-Samarqandi, may Allah be pleased with him, narrated to us, saying: Ja'far ibn Muhammad ibn Mas'ud al-Ayyashi narrated to us, from his father, saying: Ahmad ibn Ahmad narrated to us, saying: Sulayman ibn al-Khasib narrated to us, saying: The Trustworthy one narrated to us, saying: Abu Jum'a Rahma ibn Sadaqa narrated to us, saying:

A man from the Banu Umayya, who was a heretic, came to Ja'far ibn Muhammad (peace be upon them both) and said: What did Allah, Exalted and Glorious, intend by His saying in His Book: 'Alif Lam Meem Sad'? What does it include of the permissible and the forbidden? And what does it include of what people benefit from?

Then Ja'far ibn Muhammad (peace be upon them both) was angered by that, and said: Hold, woe to you. The 'Alif' is one, the 'Lam' is thirty, the 'Meem' is forty, and the 'Sad' is ninety. How much do you have with you? The man said: One and thirty and a hundred. Then Ja'far ibn Muhammad (peace be upon them both) said to him: When the year of one and thirty and a hundred ends, the reign of your people will end.
He said: Then we looked, and when the year of one and thirty and a hundred ended, on the Day of Ashura, the Blacks entered Kufa and their reign came to an end.

key_terms.الْمَسُودَةُ: The Blacks (referring to the Abbasid forces)
key_terms.الْمِصْ: Alif Lam Meem Sad (the separated letters at the start of Surah Al-A'raf)
key_terms.زَنْدِقًا: Heretic (specifically referring to the Umayyads in this context)

ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of the Quranic letters Alif Lam Meem Sad according to Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Mani al-Akhbar* illustrates the Shia scholarly tradition of interpreting the mysterious *Huruq al-Mu-Muqatta'at* through the Abjad numerical system, linking linguistic structure to historical prophecy. Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) demonstrates that the letters Alif-Lam-Mim-Sad sum to 131, foretelling the end of Umayyad dominance coinciding with the Abbasid entry into Kufa on Ashura, thereby validating the divine knowledge of the Imams.

en.basel-kadem: 5.	We were told by Mudaffar bin Ja’far bin Mudaffar al-Alawi al-Samarqandi, may Allah be pleased with him, that he said: We were told by Ja’far bin Muhammed bin Mas’ud al-Ayyashi, from his father, that he said: We were told by Ahmad bin Ahmad, that he said: We were told by Sulayman bin Khusayb, that he said: We were told by the truthful, that he said: We were told by Abu Jum’a, Rahma bin Sadaqa, that he said:

A man from the sons of Umayya, and he was a heretic, came to Ja’far bin Muhammed, peace be upon them both, and said: The saying of Allah, Exalted and Glorious is He, in His Book: «Alif Laam Meem Ssaad», what thing did He intend with it? And what does it include of what is allowed and forbidden? And what does it include of what people benefit from?

He said: Then Ja’far bin Muhammed, peace be upon them both, was angered because of that. Then he said: Hold, woe to you. The «Alif» is one, the «Laam» is thirty, the «Meem» is forty and the «Ssaad» is ninety. How much do you have with you? The man said: Thirty one and a hundred. Then Ja’far bin Muhammed, peace be upon them both, said to him: When the year thirty one and a hundred will end, the reign of your people will end.
He said: Then we looked, and when the year thirty one and a hundred ended, on the Day of Ashura, the Blacks entered Kufa and their reign came to end.
